additional_findings.finding: The new natural oracle observes request 1, not request 2. The only retained request-2 skip arm is still the validated-save-state witness that injects u16 2, so the registered natural-death residual remains open.

The 5062842-byte from-boot movie matches artifact SHA-256 b29ae839..., but has no entry in analysis/phase0_2_external_fixture_set.json. The 19 breadth movies and 19 state anchors are all centrally pinned.

The fresh detached replay reproduced every semantic field but not the submitted bytes: the generator embeds the emulator's absolute media.path. The regenerated SHA-256 is ca3fa12f... versus retained 419b229c..., with exactly one field different.

The exact submitted breadth generator cannot regenerate from the required fresh detached verifier because all 19 source paths are absolute and its output conversion assumes they lie below the detached ROOT.
